description: This file defines the AuthorizationCode grant class for the OAuth2 client library, representing the authorization code grant type as per RFC 6749. It extends an abstract grant class and provides specific implementations for retrieving the grant name and required parameters.

classes.name: AuthorizationCode
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 authorization code grant type, extending the AbstractGrant base class, and specifies the grant name and required parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the grant, which is 'authorization_code'.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns an array of required request parameters for this grant, which includes 'code'.
